messages.text: BL-1684 🎵 in progress — the pipeline board's caption cap is applied before HTML escaping - gridCaptionLine renders truncateCaptionDescription(deriveKebabSlug(title)) to 64 chars and the body is then escaped, so a 64-char '&' caption renders as 320 chars (&) and '<' as 257 (<), and a board of fifteen such rows composes to 4119-4396 chars with no link list to drop, which composePipelineBoardHtml returns over PIPELINE_BOARD_MESSAGE_MAX_LENGTH (4000) - the 2026-07-17 rejected-send outage path BL-956's invariant 1 closes; the bl956 property fails on about 1 draw in 30,000 (2 of 58,572; fast-check seed 10 within 1500 runs, deterministic), first sighted by QA in BL-1467's property lane (note 003071); the cap budgets the escaped length and the compose step never returns html over its limit
